pkgmetadata.longdescription:
rocprofv3 (rocprofiler-sdk) and rocprof-compute, extracted from AMD's prebuilt TheRock gfx1151 distribution. ROCm 7.14.0 is the release that added Strix Halo support to rocprof-compute; its profile output is keyed rdna35_halo for gfx1151.
This is a binary package: the profiler tree is self-contained under /opt/rocprofiler-therock and resolves libhsa-runtime64 and libamd_comgr from the matching system ROCm.
